subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, or should this behavior be modeled through the existing `replyToMode` threading contract?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing config surface that overlaps an existing threading setting and reopens a previously suppressed Google Chat API path, so maintainer product/API intent is needed before a durable fix shape is clear.

options.title: Choose the config API first
options.body: Recommended: decide the permanent threading API, then have the branch complete the selected type, metadata, docs, tests, and proof contract.

options.title: Accept a separate DM knob
options.body: Maintain `dmThreadMode` as a new documented Google Chat account option and require the missing generated/type/docs updates plus live DM proof before merge.

options.title: Fold it into replyToMode
options.body: Reject the separate key and ask for a narrower PR that extends the existing Google Chat threading policy if maintainers want this opt-in.

recommendation.title: Choose the config API first
recommendation.body: Recommended: decide the permanent threading API, then have the branch complete the selected type, metadata, docs, tests, and proof contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest routing candidate from prior Google Chat thread support and the maintainer verification of the merged DM thread-suppression fix.
